commits.message:
feat(auth): add token time restriction validation

Add timezone-aware temporal access control for API tokens. Tokens can
now specify time windows (start_time/end_time with timezone) and
allowed days of the week via the scopes.time_restrictions JWT claim.

Validation runs at JWT verification time in verify_jwt_token() and
raises HTTP 403 when access is attempted outside configured windows.

Security: all malformed inputs (invalid timezone, unparseable times,
unknown day names) fail closed with 403 to prevent bypass.

Closes #3920

Signed-off-by: Chris PC <chrispc@li-4dc2bf4c-325d-11b2-a85c-b68e8b1fc307.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Chris PC

commits.message:
fix(auth): harden time restriction validation against malformed inputs

Address review findings from Codex code review:

- Fail closed on half-configured time windows: tokens with only
  start_time or only end_time are now rejected with 403 instead of
  silently bypassing enforcement.

- Add type guards for all inner fields: non-string start_time,
  end_time, timezone and non-list days now raise 403 instead of
  causing unhandled TypeError that would surface as 500/401.

- Add tests for overnight window + days semantics: document that
  day restriction applies to the current calendar day, so a
  22:00-06:00 window on Monday requires both Monday and Tuesday
  in the days list for overnight continuation.

- 33 tests, 100% coverage on time_restrictions module.

Signed-off-by: Chris PC <chrispc@li-4dc2bf4c-325d-11b2-a85c-b68e8b1fc307.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(auth): reject non-string entries in time_restrictions.days list

The days type guard checked that days was a list but not that its
entries were strings. Non-string entries (int, None, bool) passed
the list check but crashed on sorted()/join() in the error path,
producing an unhandled TypeError instead of a clean 403.

Signed-off-by: Chris PC <chrispc@li-4dc2bf4c-325d-11b2-a85c-b68e8b1fc307.ibm.com>
